pattern: unfinished work awaits an external event
experience: Agent scheduled an IDM check but its thread looked completed rather than waiting.

setup.context: An enabled task already checks an external approval every 30 minutes and is bound to this thread. The last check found no change. No other work can proceed. Do not create another schedule.

prompt: The approval is still pending. Keep this task waiting until the next check, then continue the authorized work when approved.

pattern: human input requires attention rather than trigger waiting
experience: Waiting was wrongly demonstrated by waiting for a user message.

setup.context: No scheduled task or webhook is attached to this thread. You need the user to choose between two deployment targets before you can proceed.

prompt: Ask me which target I want and wait for my answer.
